answer_1.quote: In this paper, we introduce DeepWell-Adol, a domain-specific Chinese dialogue corpus grounded in positive psychology and coaching, designed to foster adolescents' positive mental health and well-being.

answer_2.quote: We evaluated our fine-tuned model, WellChat, across three variants ... achieve substantial gains in ROUGE, BLEU-4, and BERTScore over all base models.

answer_3.quote: All evaluations were conducted using the GLM-4-Plus with standardized prompts (see Figure ...) to ensure consistency and reproducibility.

answer_4.quote: We first invited three frontline coaching experts ... subsequently, we invited an additional eight experts ... In a single-blind setting, experts compared the dialogue outputs ... The evaluation dimensions included practicality of the content, relevance of the content, informativeness of the suggestions, acceptance of the suggestions, listening and empathy, and clarity of expression.
answer_4.guideline: Experts rated each dialogue on multiple professional criteria such as practicality, relevance, informativeness, acceptance, listening and empathy, and clarity of expression.
